text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three important years for <chrname> had passed. 
It was time to mark a milestone in her 
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so continued the days of visiting the 
bustling Yukoma Hot Springs resort...
choice_data_list:
I'll keep giving it my all, putting health 
first!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but... It really is hard to say 
goodbye~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Totally~~!! I'm gonna miss you so much—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it can't be helped. The 
proprietresses have gotten busier too, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. It wouldn't be good to keep 
intruding under the excuse of "studying 
rest and recuperation~," right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Gotta free up the guest rooms for the 
other girls. We'll look after ourselves♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With souvenirs and memories in our 
hearts... Let's put it into practice at 
the Academy too. Have a 'wonderful break'!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still~~, can't we stay up all night having 
fun just for today? Let's finish off with 
a pillow fight, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, pulling an all-nighter won't 
do.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
However... on the final night, we ought to 
go all out and have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—Um~, everyone. Thank you so much for 
gathering here today.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us make a toast. ...Though 
it is only juice♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
With heartfelt gratitude to everyone who 
helped rebuild our Yukoma Hot Spring 
Resort~~!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: People of Yukoma Onsen
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeeeers!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Folks from all over the hot spring town 
gathered and threw a grand banquet just 
for us!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, Trainer, you should enjoy 
yourself to the fullest too.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was taken aback when she asked 
me to teach her how to rest, but...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I ended up getting so 
much help from you!
choice_data_list: Likewise, I learned a lot from this!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Take good care of your health 
and keep doing your best for <nickname>'s sake, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's true that an Umamusume's peak is 
limited. Sometimes, unexpected injuries 
happen as well.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's too late to regret it later. It's no 
exaggeration to say that knowing how to 
rest will define your racing career.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. That's precisely why getting 
proper rest is so important."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Guiding them so they can achieve that is 
the mission of this hot spring resort, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about getting them to 
recover. To "return them in peak 
condition," there are things that neither 
hospitals nor Tracen Academy can reach.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what this hot spring resort 
is here for.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever you feel tired, come by anytime. 
Before you reach your limit, got it?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I'll heal them all, humans and horse girls 
alike, and send them on their way again!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pyoi-ya, soi-soi...♪ Status: 'Excited'.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* This is delicious~~. Tran-san, have 
you tried this?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mind if I do~... Mmm~! What is 
this ingredient? I don't think I've ever 
had it before. Time to look it up~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright, taking the picture~~! Ah, squeeze 
in a little closer...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, they even have karaoke! What are 
you gonna sing~?!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu...! Everyone is so warm and 
cozy, isn't that nice?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna hype things up even more~. 
...Haaa~~! Heaaave-hooo~!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ah, next song~? All right! Let's 
all dance together~~!
